case.summary: Case HHG-007 was triggered by a real-time model risk score of 0.87 on transaction 3514948 ($111.92) on card C09933-K2. The transaction occurred in-person in billing region 264, which is a familiar region for the cardholder with 2,220 prior purchases. However, the cardholder has a history of confirmed fraud within the last 120 days (cases CC-5521, CC-2834, and CC-2565). A verification request was sent to the customer, but no reply was received within 24 hours.
